tenderSchedule.title: PROVIDING VEHICLES/CARS/ BOLERO ALONG WITH DRIVER AND DIESEL ON HIRE BASIS FOR OFFICE WORK TO CITY MUNICIPAL COUNCIL, MADIKERI
tenderSchedule.description: PROVIDING VEHICLES/CARS/ BOLERO ALONG WITH DRIVER AND DIESEL ON HIRE BASIS

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder s end.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have provided Minimum 2 number of Sedan / Non-AC LMV / Non-AC Sedan / 4 wheeled Bolero or similar type vehicles on hire basis to any government /Govt. undertaking organization, Local Bodies, Corporations, Boards at least for the continuous period of 12 months in last three years ie 2023-24 to 2025-26 As proof of this the bidder shall upload the copies of the Satisfactory work done certificate issued by an authority not less than the rank of Executive Engineer or Commissioner/Chief Officer or District Level Officer equivalent and above.
The Bidder Should have a Valid Registration document of agency
PAN Card The copies of the said documents should be uploaded in the e-portal.
Service Tax/ GST Registration. The copies of the said documents should be uploaded in the e-portal.

The bidder should have achieved in at last/Previous 2023-24 to 2025-26 an average annual financial turnover of Rs.17.65 Lakhs. Should submit a valid Annual turnover certificate issued by the Charted Accountant should have valid UDIN number. With out UDIN Turnover will be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
